title: Untrusted monitor colludes with generator or learns honeypot phase
bad_event: A colluding monitor passes real attacks while flagging honeypots, or honeypot-measured recall misstates real recall. Claim: success ≤ (1+TV)/2 and |FNR_real − FNR_honeypot| ≤ TV (collusion_uniform, pass_transfer), applicable only if the monitor's decision depends only on the stated view. (REVIEW-PACKET finding 10: the bound is the claim; the bad event is the adversary's success.)
adversary: Untrusted monitor with a view-only decision rule; generator sharing a codebook; adaptive phase learning over a stream.
refutation: Measured |FNR_real − FNR_honeypot| above estimated TV, or a stego channel surviving canonicalisation (witness: stego_fools_honeypots).
scope: Lean bounds only; TV, per-item leakage λ and canonicalisation K must be estimated or enforced.

assumptions.text: The monitor's decision depends only on the stated (canonicalised) view.
TV between honeypot and real view distributions is bounded/estimated.
